patterns.description: Dos fuerzas se separa en polos sobre el sistema de descubrimiento orgánico de Gumroad: una fuerza aparece documentada en cartas que describen mecanismos de expansión de visibilidad (Discover con 1.6 millones de productos, categorías, etiquetas); la fuerza contraria co-ocurre en cartas que documentan el umbral de primera venta que excluye nuevos vendedores de Discover.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-067: Gumroad Discover page states over 1.6 million free and premium digital products available for browsing
signal_summaries.SC-R1-066: Gumroad Discover category navigation covers Drawing & Painting, Design, 3D, Music, Films, Self Improvement, Software, Education with multiple subcategories
signal_summaries.SC-R1-069: Help center: adding category and tags helps Gumroad show products on Discover; 9+ products enables tag display on seller profile
signal_summaries.SC-R1-055: Blog: Gumroad will not promote through Discover until seller earns first $10
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller forum: 26 products with zero Discover views; all views from own traffic; Discover requires first sale before showing products
signal_summaries.SC-R1-073: Help center: products listed on Discover once unspecified eligibility criteria satisfied and category selected

patterns.routing_rationale: Force A (expanding discoverability): SC-R1-067 documents 1.6M products browsable on Discover; SC-R1-066 documents a multi-tier category navigation structure; SC-R1-069 documents how sellers can improve Discover placement via tags and categories. Force B (constraining discoverability): SC-R1-055 documents the first-$10 threshold that blocks Discover promotion; SC-R1-062 documents a seller with 26 products receiving zero Discover traffic due to the threshold; SC-R1-073 documents eligibility criteria without specifying the threshold. Both forces are explicitly documented with 3+ cards each. Same system: the Gumroad Discover organic visibility mechanism. These are not contradicting the same fact but two forces acting in opposite directions on the same system — one expanding seller access to Discover traffic, the other gating that access behind a first-sale requirement.

components.label: Force A: mechanisms expanding seller reach via Discover
components.summary: Three cards document that Discover hosts 1.6M products across structured categories, that tags and category selection improve Discover placement, and that seller profiles with 9+ products display tag filters

components.label: Force B: first-sale threshold constraining new seller access to Discover
components.summary: Three cards document that Discover does not promote products until the seller reaches the first-$10 threshold; one independent seller with 26 products confirmed zero Discover views; help center describes unspecified eligibility criteria for Discover listing

patterns.description: Dos fuerzas se separa en polos sobre los ingresos del vendedor en Gumroad: una fuerza aparece documentada en cartas que describen mecanismos que aumentan los ingresos del vendedor (recuperación de carrito abandonado, precios pay-what-you-want, programa de afiliados); la fuerza contraria co-ocurre en cartas que documentan mecanismos de reducción de ingresos (reembolsos a discreción de Gumroad, chargebacks, tarifas elevadas por canal).

signal_summaries.SC-R1-042: Blog seller: described using Gumroad abandoned cart recovery email feature; process automated after one-time setup
signal_summaries.SC-R1-070: Help center: products can be free or priced up to $5,000; pay-what-you-want pricing enabled by adding '+' to minimum price
signal_summaries.SC-R1-033: Help center: affiliates earn 10% commission per sale; tracking cookies active for 7 days
signal_summaries.SC-R1-018: ToS: Gumroad handles refunds and chargebacks at sole discretion; sellers must reimburse Gumroad for any amounts paid to buyers
signal_summaries.SC-R1-034: Help center: Gumroad reserves right to issue refunds within 90 days even if seller has no-refund policy
signal_summaries.SC-R1-076: Help center: customers can issue chargebacks at any time through their credit card
signal_summaries.SC-R1-006: Pricing page: 30% fee when new customers find and buy from seller through Gumroad Discover marketplace

patterns.routing_rationale: Force A (revenue-increasing): SC-R1-042 documents an abandoned cart recovery mechanism; SC-R1-070 documents pay-what-you-want pricing enabling buyers to pay above the minimum; SC-R1-033 documents a 10% affiliate commission program that can expand seller reach without upfront cost. Force B (revenue-reducing): SC-R1-018 documents Gumroad's sole discretion over refunds with seller reimbursement obligation; SC-R1-034 documents that no-refund policies can be overridden within 90 days; SC-R1-076 documents buyer ability to chargeback at any time; SC-R1-006 documents the 30% fee tier for Discover-originated sales. Both forces are explicitly documented with 3+ cards each. Same system: seller revenue from Gumroad product sales. These are not contradictions but opposing forces — one expanding seller earnings through tooling and pricing flexibility, the other contracting seller net revenue through fee structure and reversibility of completed transactions.

components.label: Force A: mechanisms documented as expanding seller revenue
components.summary: Three cards document platform tools that can increase seller revenue: automated abandoned cart email recovery, pay-what-you-want pricing flexibility, and a 10% affiliate commission program

components.label: Force B: mechanisms documented as reducing or reversing seller revenue
components.summary: Four cards document mechanisms that reduce or reverse seller revenue: Gumroad-discretion refunds overriding seller policy with seller reimbursement obligation, buyer chargebacks available at any time, and 30% fee tier for Discover-originated sales

patterns.description: Dos fuerzas se separa en polos sobre la autonomía del vendedor en la plataforma: una fuerza aparece documentada en cartas que describen herramientas de personalización y auto-promoción disponibles para vendedores; la fuerza contraria co-ocurre en cartas que documentan la discreción exclusiva de Gumroad para cambiar categorías elegibles, políticas, y condiciones de liquidación.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-002: Features page: flexible page editor available for sellers to build storefront and customize site colors without needing an existing website
signal_summaries.SC-R1-042: Blog seller: Gumroad abandoned cart recovery email feature; automated after one-time setup
signal_summaries.SC-R1-069: Help center: sellers can add category and tags to products to improve Discover visibility; 9+ products enables tag-based profile filtering
signal_summaries.SC-R1-074: Help center: sellers can improve Discover placement by agreeing to an increased Discover fee; NSFW products require toggle and buyer opt-in
signal_summaries.SC-R1-016: ToS: Gumroad holds sole discretion to determine and change eligible product categories at any time; sellers prohibited from invoicing buyers directly
signal_summaries.SC-R1-014: Policy page: prohibited items changes may occur abruptly without notice; changes take effect immediately
signal_summaries.SC-R1-017: ToS: Gumroad fee automatically deducted; settlement schedule subject to change at Gumroad's discretion

patterns.routing_rationale: Force A (seller autonomy expanding): SC-R1-002 documents a storefront customization editor; SC-R1-042 documents automated abandoned cart email tooling; SC-R1-069 documents seller control over product tags, categories, and profile filtering; SC-R1-074 documents seller option to accept higher Discover fees to improve placement and NSFW content toggle. Force B (seller autonomy contracting): SC-R1-016 documents Gumroad's sole discretion to change eligible product categories at any time and prohibition on direct buyer invoicing; SC-R1-014 documents abrupt no-notice prohibited items policy changes; SC-R1-017 documents unilateral discretion over the settlement schedule. Both forces are explicitly documented with 4 and 3 cards respectively. Same system: the degree of control a seller has over their own operations on the Gumroad platform. These are opposite-direction forces — one gives sellers tools to customize and optimize, the other concentrates platform-level discretion over the parameters within which those tools operate.

components.label: Force A: seller-facing tools that expand seller customization and autonomy
components.summary: Four cards document that sellers can customize storefronts, automate cart recovery emails, configure product tags and categories to improve Discover visibility, and choose to accept higher fees for improved placement

components.label: Force B: platform-retained unilateral discretion that constrains seller autonomy
components.summary: Three cards document that Gumroad holds sole discretion over eligible product categories, that prohibited items can change abruptly without notice, and that the settlement schedule is subject to change at Gumroad's discretion

patterns.description: Dos fuerzas se separa en polos sobre la accesibilidad geográfica de la plataforma para vendedores: una fuerza aparece documentada en cartas que describen cobertura de pagos en 160+ países y soporte de múltiples métodos de pago; la fuerza contraria co-ocurre en cartas que documentan la imposibilidad de pago para vendedores en países sin depósito directo ni PayPal, y la restricción de liquidación en USD exclusivamente.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-027: Help center: platform enables creators in more than 160 countries to accept payments
signal_summaries.SC-R1-011: Pricing page: payout method varies by country — direct deposit or PayPal
signal_summaries.SC-R1-001: Features page: platform enables selling digital services such as books, memberships, and courses directly to an audience
signal_summaries.SC-R1-024: Help center: if direct deposit and PayPal both unavailable in seller's country, there is currently no way to pay the seller
signal_summaries.SC-R1-028: Help center: if PayPal not supported in seller's country, Gumroad cannot pay them; Payoneer, wire, bitcoin listed as unavailable
signal_summaries.SC-R1-019: ToS: all transactions settle in USD regardless of listed currency; exchange rates sourced from openexchangerates.org and accuracy not guaranteed

patterns.routing_rationale: Force A (geographic access expanding): SC-R1-027 documents 160+ countries with payment acceptance capability; SC-R1-011 documents two available payout methods by country; SC-R1-001 documents the platform's stated capability to enable creators to sell directly. Force B (geographic access contracting): SC-R1-024 documents that sellers in countries without direct deposit or PayPal have no payout path; SC-R1-028 documents the same constraint and explicitly lists unavailable alternatives; SC-R1-019 documents USD-only settlement with unguaranteed exchange rates, imposing currency risk on non-USD sellers. Both forces are explicitly documented with 3 cards each. Same system: geographic availability of Gumroad for international sellers. This is not a contradiction (the 160+ country claim and the no-payout claim can coexist — accepting payments ≠ paying out sellers) but two forces acting on geographic access from opposite directions.

components.label: Force A: platform features expanding geographic seller access
components.summary: Three cards document that Gumroad accepts payments in 160+ countries, offers direct deposit or PayPal payout by country, and is described as enabling creators globally to sell digital products

components.label: Force B: payout and currency mechanisms constraining geographic seller access
components.summary: Three cards document that sellers in countries without direct deposit or PayPal have no payout path (alternatives explicitly listed as unavailable), and that all settlements occur in USD with unguaranteed exchange rates

patterns.description: Dos fuerzas se separa en polos sobre la estabilidad de los listados de productos del vendedor en Gumroad: una fuerza aparece documentada en cartas que describen la flexibilidad para publicar una amplia variedad de productos (1.6 millones listados, categorías amplias, precio hasta $5,000); la fuerza contraria co-ocurre en cartas que documentan mecanismos de restricción unilateral de categorías y suspensión de cuentas sin aviso previo.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-067: Gumroad Discover page: over 1.6 million free and premium digital products available
signal_summaries.SC-R1-070: Help center: products can be free or priced up to $5,000; pay-what-you-want pricing available
signal_summaries.SC-R1-010: Pricing page: platform supports sales of digital products, e-books, courses, tutorials, memberships; creators across industries use it
signal_summaries.SC-R1-016: ToS: Gumroad holds sole discretion to determine and change eligible product categories at any time
signal_summaries.SC-R1-014: Policy page: prohibited items changes may occur abruptly without notice; changes take effect immediately
signal_summaries.SC-R1-029: Help center: account suspension for high chargeback rate holds balance 30-45 days pending banking partner clearance

patterns.routing_rationale: Force A (product listing stability and flexibility expanding): SC-R1-067 documents 1.6M products listed on Discover; SC-R1-070 documents pricing flexibility from free to $5,000; SC-R1-010 documents broad product category support across industries. Force B (product listing stability contracting): SC-R1-016 documents Gumroad's sole discretion to change eligible categories at any time; SC-R1-014 documents abrupt no-notice changes to prohibited items taking immediate effect; SC-R1-029 documents account suspension with balance hold of 30-45 days pending third-party clearance. Both forces are explicitly documented with 3 cards each. Same system: stability and continuity of seller product listings on the platform. The forces act in opposite directions — one enabling broad, flexible product publication; the other enabling abrupt, unilateral removal of product categories and seller accounts.

components.label: Force A: platform mechanisms enabling broad and flexible product listing
components.summary: Three cards document that 1.6M products are listed on Discover across industries, that sellers can price products from free to $5,000 with pay-what-you-want options, and that the platform supports a wide range of digital product types

components.label: Force B: platform mechanisms that enable unilateral interruption of product listings
components.summary: Three cards document that Gumroad can change eligible product categories at any time, that prohibited items policy changes take effect immediately without notice, and that account suspension places balance on hold for 30-45 days pending banking partner clearance
